Rosie Perez's Top 10 Movies, Ranked

Explore Rosie Perez's most powerful performances across three decades of cinema, featuring her versatility in drama, comedy, and action genres. From her breakthrough in Do the Right Thing to recent successes, discover what makes these roles special.

6 December 2024 · RewindZone Archive

Having followed Rosie Perez's career since her electrifying debut, I've watched her transform from a dynamic newcomer into one of Hollywood's most versatile actresses. Her filmography spans over three decades, showcasing an impressive range that few performers can match. Let's count down her ten most outstanding performances.

Top 10 Films

10. It Could Happen to You (1994)

Advertisement

Director: Andrew Bergman Genre: Romantic Comedy Main Cast: Nicolas Cage, Bridget Fonda, Rosie Perez

Having watched this film multiple times, I can confirm that Perez's portrayal of Muriel Lang is absolutely unforgettable. Her character's explosive energy and perfect comedic timing create some of the most memorable moments in this heartwarming tale about a police officer who shares his lottery winnings with a waitress.

9. Pineapple Express (2008)

Director: David Gordon Green Genre: Comedy/Action Main Cast: Seth Rogen, James Franco, Rosie Perez

I was particularly impressed by Perez's turn as corrupt police officer Carol Brazier. Her ability to hold her own among the film's comedy heavyweights while adding a genuine sense of menace to her character showcases her remarkable range.

8. Birds of Prey (2020)

Director: Cathy Yan Genre: Action/Comedy Main Cast: Margot Robbie, Mary Elizabeth Winstead, Rosie Perez

Watching Perez take on the role of tough-as-nails Detective Renee Montoya was a real treat. She brought a perfect blend of world-weary determination and sardonic humor to this comic book adaptation, proving she's just as capable of commanding the screen in action-packed blockbusters as she is in intimate dramas.

7. The Take (2007)

Director: Brad Furman Genre: Crime Drama Main Cast: John Leguizamo, Rosie Perez, Bobby Cannavale

The raw emotion Perez brings to her role as Felix's wife Marina left me speechless. Her portrayal of a woman dealing with the aftermath of violence feels incredibly genuine, and I found myself completely invested in her character's journey throughout the film.

6. Night on Earth (1991)

Advertisement

Director: Jim Jarmusch Genre: Comedy-Drama Main Cast: Winona Ryder, Gena Rowlands, Rosie Perez

In my opinion, Perez's segment as a motormouthed New York taxi driver is one of the film's highlights. Her natural charisma shines through in every scene, making her character's late-night journey both hilarious and touching.

5. Untamed Heart (1993)

Director: Tony Bill Genre: Romance Drama Main Cast: Christian Slater, Marisa Tomei, Rosie Perez

Every time I revisit this film, I'm struck by how Perez brings such warmth and authenticity to her supporting role as Cindy. She provides the perfect counterbalance to the main romantic storyline, adding depth and genuine friendship to the narrative.

4. Riding in Cars with Boys (2001)

Director: Penny Marshall Genre: Comedy-Drama Main Cast: Drew Barrymore, Steve Zahn, Rosie Perez

I found Perez's portrayal of Shirley Perro to be one of the film's strongest elements. She brings a wonderful mix of loyalty and tough love to her role as the protagonist's best friend, creating some of the most genuine moments in the story.

3. White Men Can't Jump (1992)

Director: Ron Shelton Genre: Comedy-Drama Main Cast: Wesley Snipes, Woody Harrelson, Rosie Perez

As Gloria Clemente, Perez delivered what I consider to be one of her most iconic performances. Her chemistry with Harrelson is electric, and her character's passion for trivia game shows adds a unique layer to this basketball-centred comedy.

2. Fearless (1993)

Director: Peter Weir Genre: Drama Main Cast: Jeff Bridges, Isabella Rossellini, Rosie Perez

In what I regard as one of her most powerful dramatic performances, Perez portrays Carla Rodrigo with devastating effectiveness. Her portrayal of a mother dealing with a survivor's guilt showcases her incredible dramatic range and earned her a well-deserved Oscar nomination.

Check out Fearless and more in our Underrated Picks of the 90s...

1. Do the Right Thing (1989)

Director: Spike Lee Genre: Drama Main Cast: Spike Lee, Danny Aiello, Rosie Perez

This breakthrough role remains one of my favorite Perez performances. From the explosive opening dance sequence to her powerful emotional scenes, her portrayal of Tina set the stage for a career filled with memorable characters. The raw energy she brings to this debut role is still electrifying to watch today.
